history.summary: A 1998 freehold 1BR (667 sqft) in D14 with excellent Eunos MRT access (510m) and a strong-looking 5.96%/yr URA rate, but built on only 9 transactions. At $1,601 PSF it's ~8% above the $1,488 median, and a 28-year-old boutique limits appreciation and exit.
history.rating_rationale: 510m to Eunos MRT and freehold D14 tenure are genuine positives, but the $1,601 PSF is ~8% above the $1,488 median and the 5.96% rate rests on just 9 txns (unreliable). At 28 years old the building faces rising maintenance and weaker resale. Score_1000 of 582 and a break-even arena record (100-98-117) confirm a middling profile.
red_flags: 5.96% appreciation built on only 9 txns — unreliable
1998 build (28 years) — ageing boutique, higher maintenance
catalysts: Eunos MRT 510m — strong connectivity for rental
D14 Paya Lebar Central / airbase relocation transformation
